name: Fried
source:
The protagonist of the story is the commander of the Balder Empire's Guerrilla Division.

Blessed with military power and talent, he is highly respected not only by his subordinates but also by the queen. He leads a small elite unit that he has personally assembled, racing across the battlefield with warlike ambition.

This time, he receives orders to capture the five countries of Philias and sets out as the frontline commander. Armed with the authority granted to him, he continues his march to establish his own country within Philias
